A repository's URL is `$HT_FORGEJO_URL/<owner>/<repo>.git`, and its wiki's `$HT_FORGEJO_URL/<owner>/<repo>.wiki.git` (pages are Markdown files on its `main`). `$HT_FORGEJO_URL` is the whole base URL (Git signs in for you) and changes from turn to turn: build every URL from it, never reuse an address from an earlier turn. Push and check the remote. Only the owner pushes branches and tags to a repository, and to its wiki, but for the root's `dev`. This opens a pull request; the newest commit message gives its title and description, and pushing the same topic updates it. Name the topic in the ref, give no push options, and push nothing else there. `forge` does not open these: read, discuss and review pull requests with `forge` or `forge api`.
